definitions.gloss: taking the initiative; taking the lead
definitions.explanation: Acting before others; being the first to do something, especially to set an example or get things moving.

examples.japanese: {率先|そっせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take the initiative and act.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{率先|そっせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The department manager took the lead and started cleaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧なら、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{率先|そっせん}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: If you want to tackle environmental issues, you need to take the lead yourself first.

notes:
Almost always used in the pattern {率先|そっせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ (taking the lead in doing something). Carries a positive nuance of leadership and setting an example.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {率先|そっせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take initiative and act
- {率先|そっせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to take the lead in tackling something
- {率先|そっせん}{垂範|すいはん}: leading by example (four-character compound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: proactive — describes attitude rather than being first to act
- ⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the front — emphasizes the position rather than the initiative
